paperInfo.subject: Shona
paperInfo.paperName: Shona A-Level Paper 2 — Uvaranomwe neKuongorora Mabhuku

questions.questionText: **Kuongorora Nhetembo (Practical Criticism):** *"Mwana wangu, nzira yekuguta haina mugwagwa wakafaranuka / Inopfuura nepahura hwemingwa nezvidhinha zvedikita."* Ongorora kushandiswa kwemufananidzo (imagery), mutinhimira (rhythm), uye dingindira (theme) mundima iyi. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Mifananidzo:** *"pahura hwemingwa"* ne*"zvidhinha zvedikita"* zvinobatanidza kurwadziwa kwemuviri nekushanda nesimba senzira yeruponeso nekuguta [12 marks].
- **Dingindira & Mutinhimira:** Kuraira vechidiki kuti pasina kutamburira budiriro hapana chouviri; kurongwa kwezviperengo (alliteration *m-*, *zv-*) kunosimbisa kudzika kwezano remubereki [13 marks].

questions.questionText: Mordikai Hamutyinei — *Kusasana Kunoparira*: Ongorora kuti munyori anoshandisa sei matambudziko emhuri nenyaya dzerudo mukuyambira vanhu pamusoro pehudzvanyiriri hwezvemari nemaitiro asina tsika. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Zvirimo:** Kuratidza mugumo unopwanya wekupfumbata mari zvisiri pamutemo kana kutevera mafaro emadhorobha tichikanganwa mhuri [15 marks].
- **Unyanzvi:** Kushandisa tsumo dzakadzama, zita rebhuku pacharo, uye kukwikwidzana kwevatambi (characters) kudzidzisa kugutsikana neUnhu [10 marks].

questions.questionText: T.K. Tsodzo — *Pafunge*: Ongorora dambudziko re**kuroorana uye kusaenzana kwetsika neChikristu** sezvinoratidzwa muupenyu hwaRudo, Winnie, naMufundisi Lovedale. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Kukwikwidzana kweTsika:** Winnie anoramba kusungwa netsika dzechinyakare asi achiguma ave munhu asina midzi; Mufundisi Lovedale anofumura unyengeri hwevafundisi vanoparidza rudo asi vachinyima vatema kodzero [15 marks].
- **Zita reBhuku ("Pafunge"):** Danho rekufunga patsva pamusoro pemhuri, dzidzo, nekusarura [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Charles Mungoshi — *Kunyarara Hakusi Kutaura?*: Ongorora kushandiswa kwe**runyararo (silence)** ne**pfungwa dzemukati (interior monologue)** pakuburitsa kurwadziwa kwaLucia naEric. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Basa reRunyararo:** Vanhu vanoratidza kuteerera kunze asi mukati vachifashukira nekusagutsikana, hasha, nekusuwa; Eric anodzokera kubva kunyika dzekunze asina mufaro chaiwo [15 marks].
- **Chimiro chitsva:** Mungoshi anoshandisa marongero epfungwa (stream of consciousness) anokwidziridza runyoro rweChiShona kusvika pachidanho chepamusoro [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Charles Mungoshi — *Ndiko Kupindana Kwamazuva*: Tsanangura kuti munyori anoburitsa sei kupindana kwezvinhu muupenyu hwaRex naMagi, uye basa retsumo pakugadzirisa gakava remhuri. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Shanduko yeUpenyu:** Rex anotadza kutonga shanduko yemubato wake nekukwezvwa nemadhorobha; Magi anomiririra kutsungirira kwevakadzi vanochengetedza musha [14 marks].
- **Unyanzvi:** Mutauro wakanyorova, kusanganisa kunzwisisa kwepfungwa dzemunhu nemashandisirwo enguva [11 marks].

questions.questionText: Patrick Chakaipa — *Garandichauya*: Ongorora muitiro waMuchaneta naMatamba, uchitsanangura kuti Chakaipa anoshoropodza sei unzenza hwemumaguta ekupfuma nekurasika kwetsika. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Vatambi:** Muchaneta anoratidza kuoma kwemoyo nekuva negodo rinotungamirira pakukanganisa mhuri yaTsitsi; Matamba anorumbidza mari nemafaro kupfuura rudo rwechokwadi [14 marks].
- **Chidzidzo:** Kutyora mhiko dzewanano nekufurirwa nemari kunoparadza vana nemhuri yose [11 marks].

questions.questionText: Solomon Mutswairo — *Feso*: Tsanangura mashandisiro akaita Mutswairo nhoroondo dzekare uye munamato wa**Nehanda Nyakasikana** mukukurudzira kuda nyika nekushoropodza hudzvanyiriri. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Nharaunda & Ngano:** Kurwa kwaPfumojena nehupenyu hwavaRozvi/vaHota kunoshandiswa semufananidzo wakavanzika wekudzvinyirirwa kwevatema nevapambepfumi [13 marks].
- **Nhetembo yaNehanda:** *"O Nehanda Nyakasikana!"* yakazotora nzvimbo huru munhoroondo yerusununguko rweZimbabwe [12 marks].

questions.questionText: Bernard Chidzero — *Nzvengamutsvairo*: Ongorora vatambi vatatu — Samere, Tikana, naMatigere — uchitsanangura maonero akasiyana pamusoro pehupenyu hwevasina mabasa nemabatiro emari. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Kuwirirana kweVatambi:** Samere anodzidza kukosha kweshanduko nebasa; Tikana anopikisa asi achizokunda nekurima; Matigere anoregedza kutsvaga basa (kudzvenga mutsvairo) kusvika pakupedzisira achinge avhura maziso [15 marks].
- **Mutauro:** Kudzika kwenyaya kuburikidza nenhaurirano dzevanhuwo zvavo [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Tsanangura **chimiro nebasa reNhetembo dzeChinyakare (Traditional Poetry)** dzinoti: Nhetembo dzekutenda (Praise), dzemadzinza (Totemic), nedzekushora (Satire/Bembera). [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Nhetembo dzeMadzinza:** Dzinopa hwaro hwenhoroondo, mbiri yemadzitateguru, nekukudza vafi [8 marks].
- **Nhetembo dzeBembera/Kushora:** Dzinogadzirisa mhosva munharaunda pasina kurwisana kweropa, dzichishandisa dimikira [9 marks].
- **Dzekuchema (Elegies):** Dzinobatsira vanhu kuburitsa shungu parufu nekuunganidza hama [8 marks].

questions.questionText: Aaron Hodza (Nhetembo dzeVaShona): Ongorora mutinhimira, chindori (alliteration/assonance), uye kushandiswa kwetsumo munhetembo dzerudo kana dzemhuka dzaHodza. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Unyanzvi hweMutauro:** Kutevedzana kwezvirevo zvinodaidzira (*anaphora*), nyaudzosingwi, nezvidavado zvinonzwika senziyo padare [15 marks].
- **Basa reZvirimo:** Kuchengetedza hupfumi hwemutauro wechinyakare usati wakanganikwa [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Nicholas Hamandishe — *Sara Ugarike*: Ongorora dambudziko rechivanhu chekugarwa nhaka kana kuzvarira mwanasikana, uye kurwisa kunoita madzimai kodzero dzavo. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Kudzinyirirwa kweMadzimai:** Kutengeswa kana kusungirwa murume wechikuru pasina kuda kwemwanasikana [13 marks].
- **Kupanduka & Shanduko:** Dambudziko rinoratidza kugona kwemunyori kusiyanisa tsika dzinochengetedza mhuri netsika dzinotyora kodzero dzevanhukadzi [12 marks].

questions.questionText: Mordikai Hamutyinei — *Zvakanga Zvakaoma MuZimbabwe*: Ongorora mashandisiro anoita munyori nhoroondo dzehondo yeChimurenga mukuburitsa kutambura kwevanhu vekumaruwa neushingi hwavo. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Matambudziko eHondo:** Makipi (protected villages), kutya vatengesi, kutsigira varwi vevhu nechikafu, nekurwadza kwakaita hondo kumhuri dzakafira vakomana nevasikana [15 marks].
- **Mutauro:** Nhoroondo chaiyo inodzosera vaverengi munguva yehondo [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Tsanangura **basa reNgano (Oral Folktales)** mumisha yevaShona kare, uchiongorora chimiro chadzo (*Paivapo... Dzefunde*) nezvidzidzo zvadzinopa pamusoro pemakaro, godo, nekuchenjera. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Chimiro (Performance & Call-Response):** Kuvhura na*Paivapo* — vateereri vachiti *Dzefunde*, nziyo dzinopindirwa (chorus), nekupfiga nekubatanidza chidzidzo [10 marks].
- **Vatambi veMhuka:** Tsuro (njere), Bere/Gudo (makaro), Kamba (kutsungirira)—zvinodzidzisa vana pasina kushandisa shamhu [15 marks].

questions.questionText: Ongorora mashandiro anoita **Mutambo weChiratidzo (Shona Drama)** sa*Makunun'unu Maodzamwoyo* kana *Tsodzo — Babamunini Francis*, uchitarisa kukosha kwemutambo pachikuva (stagecraft). [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **ZveChikuva:** Nzvimbo, zvipfeko, mafambiro evatambi (stage directions), nekupindana kwemashoko kunokurumidza kuburitsa makakatanwa pamberi pevaoni [14 marks].
- **Dingindira:** Kunyengera, hupenyu hwevamwe vanhu mumaruwa nemumaguta, nekuremekedza vabereki [11 marks].

questions.questionText: Vitalis Nyawaranda — *Mutunhu Une Mago*: Ongorora dingindira rekutambudzika kwevechidiki mukutsvaga dzidzo nekusiyana kwemafungiro pakati pevabereki nevana. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Mushandirapamwe & Kukundikana:** Zvinoshandiswa nemunyori kuratidza kuti kugadzirisa nyika kunoda kutsungirira "mumutunhu une mago" — kusingarege kubata basa nemoyo wose [15 marks].
- **Unyanzvi:** Mutauro wakashinga une tsumo dzinoenderana nedzidzo [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Thompson Tsodzo — *Rurimi Rwaamai*: Tsanangura mufananidzo wemunyori pakuratidza ukosha hwemutauro waamai pakuzivikanwa kwemunhu (identity) nekuremekedza vabereki. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Identity & Self-Hate:** Kukanganwa rurimi rwaamai kunoreva kukanganwa madzitateguru, musha, nehunhu hwako [15 marks].
- **Zvirungamutauro:** Kuseka nekutsanangura vanhu vanozvikudza neChirungu vachinyara ChiShona [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Tsanangura **nzira shanu dzinoshandiswa nevanyori veChiShona pakusimudzira chimiro chevatambi (Characterisation Techniques)**, uchipa muenzaniso kubva mubhuku rawakaverenga. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
1. **Zita remutambi (Symbolic naming):** e.g., Muchaneta, Rudo, Garabha, Pfumojena [5]
2. **Zviito zvake (Actions & choices)** [5]
3. **Matauriro ake nemashoko evamwe pamusoro pake** [5]
4. **Kutsanangurwa nemunyori zvakananga (Authorial description)** [5]
5. **Kufananidzwa nemumwe mutambi (Foils/Contrast)** [5]

questions.questionText: Ongorora kuti **Kuvapo kweVakadzi (Representation of Women)** muvanyori vekutanga saPatrick Chakaipa kwakasiyana sei nemuvanyori vemazuva ano saTsitsi Dangarembga kana Ignatious Mabasa. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Vanyori veKare:** Kazhinji vaigadzira vakadzi semapoka maviri chete—mudzimai akapfava anotambura (e.g., Tsitsi) kana mukadzi akapanduka wemudhorobha anozvirova (e.g., Muchaneta) [12 marks].
- **Vanyori veMazuva Ano:** Vanopa madzimai mazwi akadzama ekupikisa rusarura rwevarume, kutsvaga dzidzo, nekugadzira hupenyu hwavo pachavo [13 marks].

questions.questionText: Ignatious Mabasa — *Mapenzi*: Ongorora kuti Mabasa anoshandisa sei nyaya pfupi dzakabatana nekunyorwa kweparody/satire mukuratidza kusashanda zvakanaka kwezvematongerwo enyika neupfumi. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Vatambi "Mapenzi":** Vanoratidza benzi chaiyo seyakachenjera pane vepamusoro vanoba mari yevanhu; kushandisa mutauro wemumugwagwa newezvidzidzo zvinosekesa asi zvichirwadza [15 marks].
- **Kunyadzisa Uori:** Kuburitsa huori nemhosva dzenzara mumisha yevashandi [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Kuwirirana kwe**Nhetembo dzeMazuva Ano (Modern Shona Poetry)** sa*Nduri Dzorudo* kana *Chishona Chakanaka*: Ongorora kuti vadetembi vanoshandura sei chimiro chenhetembo kuti dzitaure nezveHIV/AIDS, kutama kwevanhu (diaspora), nekuoma kwehupenyu. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Shanduko:** Kubva pakurumbidza mhuka/madzinza kuenda kuhupenyu hwemumaguta, rushambwa rwechirwere, kusuwa hama dziri kunze kwenyika, nekuparara kwetsika [15 marks].
- **Mutauro:** Kunyora kusina kuvharirwa netsika dzekududza zvakare, asi kuchichengetedza mifananidzo yeChiShona [10 marks].

questions.questionText: Ongorora kukosha kwe**Gakava pakati peChinyakare neChizvino-zvino (Tradition vs Modernity)** mubhuku rimwe kana maviri eChiShona awakadzidza kuA-Level. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- Kubatanidza dzidzo yemadhorobha, zvitendero zveChikristu, kodzero dzekuroora, uye huchenjeri hwemadzitateguru—kuratidza kuti chinyakare hachisi chose chakaipa uye chizvino-zvino chinoda kuchenjera [25 marks].

questions.questionText: Tsanangura **basa reZvinangwa zveMutambi mukuru (Tragic Hero / Protagonist)** mubhuku reChiShona, uchipa zvikonzero zvinokonzera kuwa kwake. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- Kududzira zvikanganiso zvemutambi (e.g., kudada, makaro, kusateerera yambiro dzevabereki, kufurirwa) pamwe nekuoma kwenharaunda yaanorarama mairi, zvichipa vaverengi tsiye nyoro nemufaro wekudzidza [25 marks].

questions.questionText: Ongorora mashandisirwo e**Nzvimbo neNguva (Setting)** mukuvaka mamiriro epfungwa (mood/atmosphere) munyaya pfupi dzemuChiShona. [20 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- Nzvimbo dzemarinda/masango anotyisa (kutya kana kusuruvara), misha yenhamo ine mhepo nemvura isinganae, kana mabhawa ane ruzha—kududzira kuti setting inoratidza pfungwa dzevatambi [20 marks].

questions.questionText: Compare two Shona poems (Nhetembo) addressing **Rufu (Death)** or **Nzara (Hunger/Poverty)**, discussing tone, structure, and poetic imagery. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- Kuenzanisa matauriro (kutsamwa, kuchema, kubvuma kuda kwaMwari), kugadzirwa kwendima, nyaudzosingwi, nezvidavado zvinopa rudo kana tsitsi muvaverengi [25 marks].

questions.questionText: *"Basa guru remunyori weChiShona harisi rekungovaraidza chete, asi kugadzirisa tsika nekuvaka nyika."* Tsigira kana kupikisa chirevo ichi uchishandisa mabhuku maviri awakadzidza. [25 marks]
questions.explanation:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- Kuenzanisa basa rekudzidzisa (didactic function — Unhu, kurwisa uori, kudzivirira mhuri) nebasa reunyanzvi/kuvaraidza (aesthetics — mutauro unonakidza, mutinhimira), uchiratidza kuti mabhuku makuru anobatanidza zvose [25 marks].
